claims.harm: Dropping salt padding defers the initial SHA-256 chunk transform into ComputeEntry and adds an extra transform for 65-byte uncompressed keys.
claims.quote: With 33 bytes, the constructor leaves 33 bytes in the buffer and defers that transform into `ComputeEntry`. For 65-byte uncompressed keys this also crosses the 192-byte mark, needing 4 transforms instead of 3.
